attack_chains.title: PowerShell C2 Beacon & Persistence
attack_chains.description: Attacker executed encoded PowerShell commands to download and run a C2 beacon, then established persistence via scheduled tasks and a malicious service.

attack_chains.title: LSASS Credential Dump & Pass-the-Hash
attack_chains.description: Attacker used Mimikatz to dump LSASS memory and extract NTLM hashes. Harvested credentials were used for Pass-the-Hash authentication and privilege escalation.

attack_chains.title: PsExec Lateral Movement & Internal Discovery
attack_chains.description: Using harvested credentials, the attacker moved laterally to WIN-SOC-PROD-03 via PsExec, spawned a remote shell, and performed internal network and system discovery.

attack_chains.title: Ransomware Staging & Defense Evasion
attack_chains.description: Attacker disabled Windows Defender and audit logging, deleted Volume Shadow Copies, disabled system recovery, then deployed ransomware payload to encrypt files on WIN-SOC-PROD-04.

mitre_techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys

attack_chains.title: DCSync & Golden Ticket / Kerberoasting Attack
attack_chains.description: Attacker abused Domain Admin privileges to perform DCSync and extract the krbtgt hash, enabling Golden Ticket forgery. Kerberoasting was also observed to collect additional service account hashes.

mitre_techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Golden Ticket

attack_chains.title: Phishing → Macro Execution → DNS Exfiltration
attack_chains.description: User opened a malicious macro-enabled Word document from a phishing email. Macro spawned WScript and MSHTA for payload delivery, then DNS tunneling was used to exfiltrate sensitive data via encoded TXT queries.
